name: srp_phat
blocker: No SRP-PHAT runner in this experiment. Script 01 persists TOA only (results/sim_data.npz holds mic_positions, source_pos, room_dim, tau_measured, tau_analytic, fs, c — no waveforms), so SRP-PHAT cannot be run. pyroomacoustics.doa.SRP is unused. A new SRP table would not be an existing-code result.
note: Existing code is TOA LS / offset-aware MAP, not SRP-PHAT.
